notes: OBSERVATION DATE 2026-10-11. Source sup-used-newegg-tesla-p40. The Tesla P40 (24GB GDDR5, Pascal GP102) remains a classic budget homelab LLM card due to its native INT8 DP4A support (47 TOPS INT8) and 24GB VRAM for under $400 ($16.58 per GB of VRAM). Key gotchas: Pascal lacks FP16 tensor cores (FP16 runs at 1/64 FP32 speed, so FP16 inference is unusable; GGUF/llama.cpp INT8/Q4_0 DP4A or Q8 quantization is required); passive cooling requires 3D-printed fan shrouds and high-static-pressure fans for desktop workstations; requires 'Above 4G Decoding' and motherboard PCIe BAR resizing. The corpus contains no standalone accelerator record for tesla-p40, so accelerator_ids is empty []. Note: eBay queries returned HTTP 403 Forbidden on 2026-10-11.
